snippet.title: Space Tales Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Space Tales is an epic space opera that delivers the tactical complexity of classic RTS gameplay within a universe where ancient horrors lurk beyond the stars. Follow Xander's journey from a loyal Inter-Planetary Expansion (IPE) soldier to a champion who uncovers the darkest secrets of the cosmos. Check it out on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2457960/Space_Tales/

#RTS #Space Tales

Space Tales brings the golden age of retro RTS games into 2025 with this exciting space tales trailer showcasing a new RTS game that pays homage to classic RTS titles. This sci-fi RTS combines the best strategy games elements with modern innovation, delivering RTS gameplay that mirrors StarCraft 2 in tactical depth. Whether you're a veteran of real time strategy games or new to strategy games PC, Space Tales offers engaging base building games mechanics and real time tactical games combat that will satisfy fans of tactical games and new strategy games alike. Experience an all-new video game with never-seen-before space tale units such as space tales bouncer, space tales tank, that captures the essence of retro RTS while pushing the boundaries of what RTS games PC can achieve. Join us as we develop the real time strategy game of our dream and discover why Space Tales is your next favorite new RTS games maybe your even your next favorite strategy games of the year. Don't miss our unique take the RTS games experience with Space Tales gameplay!
